generalEvidence: Endorsement editorials dated Oct 13-16, 2026, e.g. "Voters in the 77th District ... will literally see deja vu all over again on the Nov. 3 ballot". Earlier items on the index (Feb-Mar 2026) are primary endorsements and were skipped.
whyItCounts: Newspaper editorial board (counts under the voter-guide rules).

verify.note: Endorsement editorials dated Oct 13-16, 2026 (e.g. Hernandez piece cites 'the Nov. 3 ballot'). 12 entries are on the index page 1; Santa Maria/Grasse/Canty and Morrison/Katz Muhl are on ?pagenum=2. Full names and districts confirmed in each article (Syed/Levin/McLaughlin, Hernandez, Santa Maria/Grasse/Canty, Morrison/Katz Muhl). Non-Cook picks on the index (Blair-Sherlock 46, Ellman 21, Gupta 41, DeLaRosa 42, Perez 42, Rodriguez 83, Scopa 84) are correctly left out.
